subject: Privileged report: conditional access and redaction clauses
messages:
From: Darius Patel <dpatel@acme-corp.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Leila Gomez <lgomez@acme-corp.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: full PT report + exec summary (NDA/redaction options)

Connor —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our procurement and technical review, Acme needs access to Redwood's most recent penetration test and an executive summary we can share with our internal risk committee and external auditors. We understand the sensitivity and are prepared to sign a mutual NDA.

Primary asks:
- Exec summary suitable for distribution to our board (redacted PII/credentials ok)
- Access to the full report under an NDA / secure viewer for our internal security team and our retained auditors (2 people)
- A proposed redaction matrix that lists what you would redact and why (hostnames, internal IPs, exploit PoC, customer data, etc.)

Questions:
1) Will you provide a watermarked PDF exec summary, or do you require additional redactions?
2) Do you support ephemeral secure-viewer links (no download) or will you only provide file handoff?
3) What timeline do you need for legal review / redaction? Our procurement window is two weeks.

Appreciate any sample NDA text you can circulate.

Best,
Darius
Darius Patel
Manager, Vendor Risk — Acme Corporation
[Acme logo]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Darius Patel <dpatel@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: full PT report + exec summary (NDA/redaction options)

Darius — thanks for the clear asks. We can absolutely accommodate this; high level answers below and Kimberly from InfoSec will follow with the redaction matrix and suggested workflow.

Short answers:
- We can provide a watermarked exec summary suitable for board review (PDF, single-page executive digest + two-page risk table).
- Full report: requires a signed mutual NDA and access via our secure viewer (no-download, ephemeral links tied to SSO/OTP). We do not hand off unredacted raw exploit PoC outside of an NDA/approved auditor process.
- Timeline: if we receive a signed NDA by EOD Friday (2028-01-13), we can deliver the watermarked exec summary and a proposed redaction matrix by Monday (2028-01-15). Secure-viewer access for auditors can be provisioned within 48 hours of NDA signature.

I'll loop in Kimberly to outline the redaction categories and provide the redaction_matrix_v1. Also attaching a draft mutual NDA exemplar for your legal to review; we'll send via DocuSign once we have agreement on scope and signatories.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Acme reviews the attached NDA draft and confirms signatories.
2) Redwood sends redaction matrix and watermarked exec summary (redacted) for review.
3) If acceptable, Acme signs NDA and provides list of auditor emails for ephemeral viewer access.

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-nda-connor-20280112.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Darius Patel <dpatel@acme-corp.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: full PT report + exec summary (NDA/redaction options)

Darius / Connor — I'm Kimberly on Redwood InfoSec. Per Connor's note, attached is our initial redaction matrix (redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx). Summary of our approach:

Redaction categories (high level):
- Category A: Customer PII / third-party data — always redacted.
- Category B: Internal hostnames / IPs — redacted for board-facing exec summary; partial reveal in auditor-only views on a need-to-know basis.
- Category C: Exploit PoC code and step-by-step reproduction — redacted unless Acme's retained auditor signs a non-disclosure addendum and reviews inside the secure viewer (no download).
- Category D: Vulnerability IDs and severity classifications — included in exec summary and risk table.

Evidence handling options:
1) Exec summary (redacted, watermarked PDF) — suitable for broad distribution. [Attachment: redacted-execsum-watermarked.pdf]
2) Secure viewer for auditors — ephemeral link, SSO/OTP, IP restriction optional, view-only with time-limited access. Audit log provided.
3) Escrowed evidence for regulators / legal — available under legally binding handback procedures (rare).

We recommend the following contract language snippets to add to an NDA or SOW:
- Definition of "Confidential Security Materials" (includes raw exploit code, IPs, logs) and permitted recipients (Acme security team + named auditors).
- Access controls (viewer only, no download, watermarking, session logging).
- Evidence retention and destruction timelines post-review (default 90 days unless otherwise negotiated).

If Acme's auditors need sampling of evidence, we'll provide a scoped, time-bound viewer session and an evidence index rather than full file transfer. Happy to redline the NDA with these clauses; I'm copying suggested phrasing into the attached XLS for legal.

Kimberly Park
Director, Information Security | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx]

Connor / Kimberly — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Our internal auditors only need the exec summary and a redacted technical appendix that lists affected components, CVE references, and remediation recommendations. We do not require exploit PoC.
2) For procurement sign-off we need to show our legal the standard NDA language and confirm we can obtain an audit-trace of viewer sessions.
3) Timeline: We can sign a mutual NDA by next Wednesday (2028-01-18) if the NDA is acceptable. If you can provide the watermarked exec summary and the proposed redaction matrix now, that will speed review.

Requests:
- Please upload the watermarked exec summary to a secure link (we prefer a SSO/OTP viewer, not an emailed PDF).
- Please confirm whether your viewer supports IP allowlist and per-session audit logs.

Thanks — I can be the main point for the procurement/legal review.

Leila Gomez
